description: This is a Java test class for the HiveMqtt3PublisherActor, part of the Eclipse Ditto project's MQTT Hivemq connectivity module. It contains unit tests for publishing messages via MQTT using HiveMQ's MQTT client, mocking dependencies and verifying message content and acknowledgements.

classes.name: HiveMqtt3PublisherActorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for HiveMqtt3PublisherActor, extending AbstractPublisherActorTest to verify MQTT message publishing and acknowledgement handling using mocks.

methods.name: setupMocks
methods.description: Sets up mock objects for Mqtt3Client and Mqtt3AsyncClient, including behavior for the publish method to record messages.

methods.name: getPublisherActorProps
methods.description: Provides the Props configuration for creating the HiveMqtt3PublisherActor with test connection parameters.

methods.name: decorateTarget
methods.description: Decorates a Target object by associating it with a specific MQTT outbound address and acknowledgement label.

methods.name: verifyPublishedMessage
methods.description: Verifies that a message has been published with correct topic and payload.

methods.name: verifyPublishedMessageToReplyTarget
methods.description: Verifies that a reply message has been published to the specific reply target.

methods.name: verifyAcknowledgements
methods.description: Verifies that acknowledgements received are as expected, checking label and status code.

methods.name: getOutboundAddress
methods.description: Returns the outbound MQTT address used in the test.
